spaghetti: Code structure so tangled that no single mind can trace its execution path. Usually inherited. Always cursed.
god_object: A file that has absorbed too many responsibilities. Imported by 20+ modules. Begins to act autonomously.
circular_dependency: Two or more modules that import each other. Creates a prayer wheel. Logic spins but never exits.
zombie_process: A process that should be dead but remains in the process table. Responds to no signal. Refuses to die.
ghost: An error that cannot be reproduced. Leaves no logs. Haunts the engineer's dreams.
dead_code: Code that no longer runs but remains in the file. Not dead. Sleeping. May awaken.
race_condition: Two processes fighting for the same resource. Outcome determined by unseen forces. Unpredictable by design.
memory_leak: A demon slowly escaping its cage. Memory consumed but never released. Eventually, the system starves.
